scientific_scope: broader reused calibration confirmation of a development-selected arm; historically target-exposed; not fresh, not holdout, and not an unbiased generalization estimate

hypothesis_provenance.candidate_origin: F was fixed after development on already-opened edge-v1 calibration records 120:168 and an already-opened DualNAF-stack panel 636:668
hypothesis_provenance.development_result_636_668: F mean 0.269138 versus A 0.255451 and B/h28 0.266820, gain +0.002318 versus B, 32/32 wins
hypothesis_provenance.rejected_complication: Adding the historical DualNAF alpha=.125 bridge before F gave only +0.000565 versus F and 17/32 wins; v2 therefore contains no neural renderer
hypothesis_provenance.not_a_claim: Development values are adaptive and target-exposed; only the frozen v2 primary gate may authorize confirmation

fixed_pipeline.layout: bilateral directional scores -> solve_buddies(max_edges=96), strict upright permutation of all 576 input tiles
fixed_pipeline.postassembly_order: RGB seam offsets -> bounded luminance gains -> independently compute h20/h28/h40 single-pass NLM outputs -> derive exact v1 t40 mask from h20 -> fixed h28/h40 spatial blend

mask_algorithm.mask_source: independent colored NLM h20/hColor20 single-pass uint8 RGB; h20 is mask-only for candidate F
mask_algorithm.grid_protection: for coordinates 20,40,...,460 set rows and columns [coordinate-1:coordinate+1] true
mask_algorithm.soft_safe_weight: clip(cv2.GaussianBlur(float32 dilated mask, ksize=(0,0), sigmaX=1.0, sigmaY=1.0),0,1)
mask_algorithm.exact_relation_to_v1: identical E_flat_h40_t40 mask algorithm and h20 mask source; only the protected blend source changes from h20 to h28

target_access_order: verify only input PNGs and the exact selected roster
solve and audit the shared strict layout
freeze harmonized canvas, independent h20/h28/h40 images, exact binary/soft mask and all three final arm predictions
write and read back a content-addressed commitment with target-free safety diagnostics
only then decode primary target PNGs once

manual_review.compare: F versus A and B after prediction commitment
fail_on: new smooth blob crossing a protected content edge or tile boundary
material loss of identifiable text, face, or object edge relative to B
halo or contour artifact caused by the soft mask
new local discontinuity between h28-protected and h40-flat regions

selection_rule: F is the only candidate and passes only if every numeric and manual primary gate passes; A and B are controls and cannot win. Do not access confirmation after any failed check.
confirmation_gate: The unchanged F implementation, h20-derived t40 mask, thresholds and all identical numeric/manual gates must pass on ranked reused-calibration records 0:60.
forbidden: changing the h20-derived t40 mask after target access
per-board, per-image-class, filename-dependent, or target-dependent routing
new arm, mask threshold, or blend after primary target access
DualNAF or any neural renderer in this v2 experiment
tile substitution, rotation, resampling, spatial warp, or geometry change
changes to edge-protected v1 files, artifacts, production code, or production ZIP
